profile.title: About
profile.summary: Waterloo CS, math, and physics alum. Builds tools, games, and small systems.
profile.headline: I build small systems and swap the skin later.
profile.bio:
University of Waterloo alum — computer science, with math and physics in the mix. I like making tools, games, and small systems, then trying a different surface on the same material.

Interests I keep coming back to: hackathons, music, boxing, cooking, robotics, and markets. This site owns the writing and work once so different frontends can wear it.
